skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
The outfit this Operator wears most often.
While not as practical as a uniform, it's what they find most comfortable.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
An outfit that has been improved after the Operator's Promotion.
Custom-made to suit each Operator's experiences and needs, these outfits are designed to provide them maximum flexibility on any battlefield. Furthermore, this is all done without compromising the comfort that they've come to expect.

skins.name: Frosted Breath
skins.content: Cambrian 1097 Winter New Arrivals/Frosted Breath. Layered insulating design, free to be mixed and matched to individual taste. Catered to the client's personal needs, this fit has been altered by hand, adjusting the left sleeve's opening and adding an arm guard.
skins.quote: Cold cannot hinder the thirst for knowledge.

skins.name: Lacquer
skins.content: Pioneer Series/Lacquer. Raythean Industrial's new product is fully sealed and made with special fabrics that are resistant to even the harshest environmental conditions. Its dust-proof design is suitable for researchers who enter and exit dangerous areas.
skins.usage: Special work clothes designed by Raythean Industrial.
skins.quote: She spends more time in her work attire than normal.
